scope: One identity-foundation vertical slice only: current_source.addresses -> proposed_location_record + proposed_registry_subject + proposed_legacy_crosswalk

reviewed_transform.identity_rule: addresses.id owns an internal address location identity; building_id, road_id, territory_id, superseded_by_address_id and public_code are context only and must not determine the target identity

target_identity_rule.second_fixture_rule: For source id phase-a-addresses-<suffix>, use location_record_id phase-a-location-address-reference-<suffix>, subject_id phase-a-subject-phase-a-location-address-reference-<suffix>, and legacy_crosswalk_id phase-a-crosswalk-addresses-<suffix>-id-to-location-record. This is a design-harness rule only, not a production national identifier policy.

expected_absent_rows.reason: Reference and lifecycle fields are context only in this identity slice; their future resolution belongs to separately reviewed groups
Reference fields must not become alternate address identities
Identity foundation creates the identity shell only; version creation requires a separate reviewed transform
The non-official fixture public_code must not create a public-code alias
Identity creation does not authorize publication
Geometry output belongs to the separately accepted geometry transform

semantic_uniqueness.rule: Because proposed_legacy_crosswalk has no lifecycle columns, (source_table, source_field, legacy_id, target_entity) is absolutely unique in this design. It must resolve to exactly one target_id or no row; multiple rows or multiple targets fail closed.

required_tests.expected: The exact three inserted rows and all expected absences match this oracle
First run inserts three rows; second run inserts zero and updates zero

required_tests.expected_error: addresses source record lineage not found
addresses source record must remain government-internal
addresses evidence object must remain government-internal
addresses identity must derive from addresses.id
addresses identity rows differ from reviewer-owned expected target identity
addresses identity crosswalk semantic uniqueness violated
addresses identity transform specification binding mismatch

required_tests.expected: Two addresses source identities create two location records, two active subjects and two distinct crosswalks with zero semantic duplicates or multiple target resolution
A separate read-only comparator compares all attributable location-record, subject and crosswalk rows in both directions and rejects target writes
Every failing database mutation preserves identical pre-test and post-rollback attributable rows and hash before reset

prohibited: Implementing address_points, address_records, citizen_geotag_submissions or any additional identity group
Creating location-record versions, geometry, public-code aliases, publication items or migration exceptions in this slice
Using building_id, road_id, territory_id, superseded_by_address_id, public_code, labels or status fields as the address identity
Requesting broad Phase A reassessment or SDA Review 12
Closing F02 or F14 or modifying F04-F12

Modifying runtime application/frontend code, executable migrations, migration runner, Docker runtime, production/pilot data, secrets, .env files, publication, certificates, signage, partner release or PR #8
